coordinateNote: Coordinates come from three sources: the Saved Places JSON export (verified Google Maps pins), web research (Tabelog, official sites, NAVITIME), and the GSI address-search API for bars with known addresses. Some pins are address-level approximations, not verified entrances. Check opening hours and reservations directly with each bar.

bars.name: Star Bar Ginza
bars.station: Ginza (Tokyo Metro Ginza/Marunouchi/Hibiya) — 3 min walk
bars.description: One of Ginza's most respected cocktail bars. A short counter, ice carved by hand, and drinks built with a precision that makes the room go quiet. The kind of place where you order one thing and stay for three.

bars.name: Apollo Bar Ginza
bars.station: Shimbashi (JR / Tokyo Metro) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A Ginza cocktail bar with a modern, relaxed feel compared to the old-school counters nearby. Good for a long evening that starts here and moves.

bars.name: Vampire Café
bars.station: Ginza (Tokyo Metro Ginza/Marunouchi/Hibiya) — 4 min walk
bars.description: A Gothic vampire-themed bar in Ginza. Red velvet, candelabra, cocktails served in syringes and skulls. It is unapologetically theatrical, and that is the point.

bars.name: Ori Japanese Whisky Store
bars.station: Ginza (Tokyo Metro Ginza/Marunouchi/Hibiya) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A dedicated Japanese whisky bar and shop in Ginza. Deep selection of single casks and distillery exclusives you will not find outside Japan. Tasting flights, knowledgeable staff, and bottles available to go.

bars.name: JBA Bar
bars.station: Ginza (Tokyo Metro Ginza/Marunouchi/Hibiya) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A Ginza bar associated with the Japan Bartenders Association. Old-school counter, classic preparations, no shortcuts.

bars.name: Lamp Bar
bars.station: Ginza (Tokyo Metro Ginza/Marunouchi/Hibiya) — 4 min walk
bars.description: A warm, lamplit Ginza counter bar. Quiet, intimate, and the kind of place where the bartender remembers what you drank last time.

bars.name: Nocturne Wine & Whisky Bar
bars.station: Shimbashi (JR / Tokyo Metro) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A Ginza bar that splits its attention between wine and whisky, which is rarer than it sounds. Good by the glass on both sides.

bars.name: Akita Dining Namahagé Ginza
aliases: 秋田ダイニング なまはげ銀座店
bars.station: Shimbashi (JR / Tokyo Metro) — 5 min walk
bars.description: An Akita prefecture regional dining bar in Ginza. Namahagé demon-mask décor, Akita sake list, and regional dishes you will not find elsewhere in Tokyo. Drink the sake, eat the kiritanpo, stay for the atmosphere.

bars.name: New York Bar
bars.address: Park Hyatt Tokyo, 52F, 3-7-1-2 Nishishinjuku, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Shinjuku (JR / Tokyo Metro / Odakyu / Keio) — 10 min walk
bars.description: The bar from Lost in Translation. Fifty-second floor of the Park Hyatt, floor-to-ceiling windows, a live jazz trio, and a whisky list that runs deep. Expensive, and worth it once. Go early on a weeknight for a seat by the window.

bars.name: Bar Cocktailbook Shinjuku
aliases: バー カクテルブック 新宿
bars.station: Shinjuku (JR / Tokyo Metro / Odakyu / Keio) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A Shinjuku cocktail bar with a bookshelf of cocktail recipes behind the counter. The bartender will make you something off the page if you ask. A quieter alternative to the Ginza circuit.

bars.name: Bar Lonely
bars.station: Shinjuku (JR / Tokyo Metro / Odakyu / Keio) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A Kabukicho bar that does not try to be anything other than a bar. Counter seats, strong drinks, no attitude. The name is the vibe.

bars.name: BAR COO
bars.station: Shinjuku (JR / Tokyo Metro / Odakyu / Keio) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A Kabukicho counter bar near Bar Lonely. Small, dark, and serious about the drinks.

bars.name: Bar rest fine
aliases: バー レストフィン
bars.station: Shinjuku (JR / Tokyo Metro / Odakyu / Keio) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A Kabukicho bar with a relaxed, restful name. A counter spot for a late drink after the area has gotten loud.

bars.name: Eigakan Jazz
bars.station: Shinjuku (JR / Tokyo Metro / Odakyu / Keio) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A jazz bar in Kabukicho with a cinema-themed name. Records on vinyl, dim light, and a counter that faces the speakers.

bars.name: SAKE MARKET Shinjuku
bars.station: Shinjuku (JR / Tokyo Metro / Odakyu / Keio) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A sake bar in Shinjuku with a rotating selection by the glass. Good for a tasting flight before moving on to dinner.

bars.name: KURO Bar
bars.station: Yotsuya (JR / Tokyo Metro Marunouchi) — 2 min walk
bars.description: A Yotsuya bar on the Shinjuku side of the station. Small, dark, and deliberate about its name — kuro means black.

bars.name: JANAI COFFEE
bars.address: B1F Yamanen Building, 2-3-13 Ebisuminami, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Ebisu (JR Yamanote / Tokyo Metro Hibiya) — 3 min walk
bars.description: It is called a coffee shop. It is not a coffee shop. JANAI means 'not this' — the door is a speakeasy entrance, and what is behind it is a bar. Go down the stairs, find the door, and order a drink. The coffee is a cover story.

bars.name: A10
bars.station: Ebisu (JR Yamanote / Tokyo Metro Hibiya) — 3 min walk
bars.description: An Ebisu bar around the corner from JANAI. Small, focused, and easy to miss if you are not looking for it.

bars.name: Ginger Whisky Bar
aliases: ジンジャーウイスキーバー
bars.station: Ebisu (JR Yamanote / Tokyo Metro Hibiya) — 4 min walk
bars.description: An Ebisu whisky bar with a deep selection and a ginger theme. Warm, small, and serious about its pours.

bars.name: FIGHTCLUB Shibuya
bars.station: Shibuya (JR / Tokyo Metro / Tokyu / Keio Inokashira) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A Shibuya bar with a name that tells you the vibe. Loud, young, and not the place for a quiet whisky.

bars.name: BUNDAN Coffee & Beer
bars.station: Shibuya (JR / Tokyo Metro / Tokyu / Keio Inokashira) — 4 min walk
bars.description: A Shibuya spot that serves both coffee and beer. Daytime café, evening bar. A good bridge between afternoon and night.

bars.name: Bar sawa
bars.station: Nakameguro (Tokyo Metro Hibiya) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A bar in Higashiyama, the quiet side of Nakameguro. A counter spot for a drink before or after dinner in the neighborhood.

bars.name: Gen Yamamoto
bars.station: Azabujuban (Toei Oedo) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A reservation-only cocktail bar in Azabujuban. One bartender, a short counter, and a tasting-menu-style flight of seasonal cocktails built on Japanese ingredients. Sit, watch, do not rush.

bars.name: Bar Centifolia
aliases: バー センティフォリア
bars.station: Azabujuban (Toei Oedo) — 3 min walk
bars.description: An Azabujuban bar near Gen Yamamoto. A quieter, older-school counter for a late drink in the neighborhood.

bars.name: Rokusan Angel (Burlesque Tokyo)
bars.station: Roppongi (Toei Oedo / Tokyo Metro Hibiya) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A Roppongi burlesque bar. Live performances, cocktails, and a stage that is close enough to touch. Book ahead.

bars.name: Sake Bar O
bars.station: Omotesando (Tokyo Metro Ginza/Hanzomon/Chiyoda) — 8 min walk
bars.description: An exclusive sake club in Minamiaoyama. Members-only access, a curated cellar of rare and seasonal brews, and staff who can tell you the brewery, the yeast strain, and the rice polish rate for every pour. The kind of place where you learn what sake can be.
bars.note: Reservation or membership required. Check access before visiting.

bars.name: BAR &UNDER
aliases: バー アンドアンダー
bars.address: B1F Sotokanda Kanemura Building, 2-6-4 Sotokanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Akihabara (JR / Tokyo Metro Hibiya) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A basement bar in Kanda, near Akihabara. The name tells you where to look — go down. A good late-night stop in a neighborhood that shuts early.

bars.name: bar alchemist
aliases: バー アルケミスト
bars.station: Akihabara (JR / Tokyo Metro Hibiya) — 4 min walk
bars.description: A Kanda cocktail bar with an alchemist's name. Experimental preparations, a short menu, and a counter that rewards attention.

bars.name: EXBAR TOKYO plus Akihabara
bars.station: Akihabara (JR / Tokyo Metro Hibiya) — 2 min walk
bars.description: A bar in the Akihabara station passage. Easy to find, easy to stop in, and a good meeting point before heading deeper into the neighborhood.

bars.name: BAR Willow's
bars.station: Ueno (JR / Tokyo Metro Ginza/Hibiya) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A bar in Ueno near the station. A reliable stop for a drink before or after the park, the museums, or the Ameyoko market.

bars.name: The TRAD whisky & cocktails
bars.station: Ueno-Hirokoji (Tokyo Metro Ginza) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A whisky and cocktail bar in Yushima, between Ueno and Okachimachi. The name says what it is. A solid counter, a deep whisky shelf, and no pretense.

bars.name: Hookah & Bar BASE
bars.station: Ueno-Hirokoji (Tokyo Metro Ginza) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A hookah bar in Yushima near Ueno. Flavored tobacco, drinks, and a relaxed room. A different pace from the cocktail counters.

bars.name: Rock Bar Sakebi
aliases: ロックバー さけび
bars.station: Nippori (JR Yamanote / Keisei) — 8 min walk
bars.description: A rock bar in Negishi, north of Ueno. Loud music, strong drinks, and a crowd that came for both. Not the place for a quiet conversation.

bars.name: Cafe & Bar TREE BAR
bars.station: Asakusabashi (JR Soban / Toei Asakusa) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A café and bar in Yanagibashi, near Asakusabashi. A quiet spot in an old downtown neighborhood that most tourists skip.

bars.name: Game Bar A-Button
aliases: ゲームバー エーボタン
bars.station: Taito-cho (Toei Asakusa) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A game bar in Taito. Retro consoles behind the counter, drinks in front, and you can borrow a controller. A good stop if you want a drink and a round of something old.

bars.name: No Room For Squares
aliases: ノー・ルーム・フォー・スクエアーズ
bars.station: Shimokitazawa (Odakyu / Keio Inokashira) — 3 min walk
bars.description: A jazz bar in Shimokitazawa. The name is a Mingus reference. Vinyl on the turntable, a small room, and a crowd that came for the music. Check the schedule.

bars.name: Shooting Bar EA
aliases: シューティングバー エーエー
bars.station: Kichijoji (JR Chuo / Keio Inokashira) — 8 min walk
bars.description: A shooting bar in Kichijoji. Airsoft rifles, a target range, and drinks. Not a cocktail bar, but a uniquely Tokyo evening out. Musashino is outside the 23 wards but reachable on the Chuo line.

bars.name: The Pizza Bar On 38th
aliases: ザ ピザバー オン 38th
bars.address: 38F Mandarin Oriental Tokyo, 2-1-1 Nihonbashi Muromachi, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
bars.station: Mitsukoshimae (Tokyo Metro Ginza/Hanzomon) — 2 min walk
bars.description: A pizza bar on the 38th floor of the Mandarin Oriental. Yes, pizza — wood-fired, counter seating, and a view that rivals New York Bar's. Expensive, and the pizza is better than it has any right to be at that altitude.

bars.name: a BAR Sleeping Tales
aliases: ア バー スリーピング テイルズ
bars.station: Shinjuku (JR / Tokyo Metro / Odakyu / Keio) — 5 min walk
bars.description: A Shinjuku bar with a storybook name. A quiet counter for a late drink, away from the Kabukicho noise.
